title: DASH & CENTER PLENUM PANEL
summary: All models: the fiberglass dash panel (firewall/cowl dash) and center plenum panel (cowl plenum under the windshield) with their small riveted-on reinforcements for the windshield wiper (WSW) motor, the wiper limit switch bracket and the wiper stop bracket. The dash panel is bonded to the underbody and cab frame with cement/sealer, riveted to the hinge pillar outer reinforcements and the lower windshield frame, using 52f sealer on coupes or 87a adhesive on convertibles; the wiper stop bracket is screwed on (20-30 lb-in).
